title: The Eagle
author: Alfred, Lord Tennyson
lines: He clasps the crag with crooked hands;
Close to the sun in lonely lands,
Ring'd with the azure world, he stands.
The wrinkled sea beneath him crawls;
He watches from his mountain walls,
And like a thunderbolt he falls.
note: Full text · Public domain. Published 1851; Tennyson died in 1892.

title: Aku
author: Chairil Anwar
lines: Dan aku akan lebih tidak perduli
Aku mau hidup seribu tahun lagi
note: Teks lengkap · Domain publik di Indonesia (Chairil Anwar wafat 1949; perlindungan hak cipta berakhir 2019). Ditulis Maret 1943.
